newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes end firmer, grades mostly steady.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes end firmer, grades mostly steady.

text.p: U.S. crudes ended higher Monday on the strength displayed in European markets due to extremely cold temperatures across the continent.
Cash crudes were mostly steady, though some interest perked up the West Texas Sour/Midland market later in the session, leaving prices at the stronger end of recent ranges.
"It just crept higher, and looked like the workings of a really thin market more than anything else," a trader said.
Outrights were already trading in pre-holiday fashion ahead of the New Year's break. The NYMEX closes early at 1300 EST Dec 31 and will reopen for a regular session Jan 2.
